title: collapseThreads: reported total is wrong when COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS truncates
description: When collapseThreads=true and the account has more than 65536 emails, the handler caps the fetch at COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS, collapses that slice, and reports total=unique_threads_in_fetched_slice. The real total (unique threads across all emails) is higher. RFC 8620 §5.5: total is 'the total number of objects in the results'. Options: (a) don't report total when truncating (set to null), or (b) explicitly document and test this invariant. Currently the truncation comment is on the constant not on the response field.
